Selected projects

★ FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Have a project in mind? Here are answers to common questions about my services, process, and how we can work together.

How do I request a consultation?

Visit my contact page and share a brief description of your project. Include your goals, the services you need, and your preferred timeline so we can discuss the next steps.

What services do you offer?

I offer website design and development, mobile app UI/UX design, interactive prototyping, and graphic design. We can discuss your requirements and choose the services that best support your project.

What information do you need to get started?

A clear project brief is a good starting point. Share your goals, target audience, required features, preferred timeline, and any examples you like. Existing brand assets, text, and images are also helpful.

Can you redesign an existing website or app?

Yes. I can review your current website or app design and help improve its appearance, usability, and overall experience. The scope may involve refining selected screens or developing a more comprehensive redesign.

Will my website work on mobile devices?

Responsive layouts are part of my website design and development process. I adapt content, navigation, and interactions for different screen sizes so visitors can use your website comfortably on phones, tablets, and desktop computers.

How much will my project cost?

Pricing depends on the scope, complexity, required deliverables, and timeline. After reviewing your brief, I can prepare a quote that explains the proposed work and what is included.

How long does a project take?

The timeline depends on the size of the project, its technical requirements, and the availability of content and feedback. We will agree on a realistic schedule and key milestones before work begins.

What does your design process involve?

My process typically includes understanding your goals, planning the structure, exploring design ideas, and refining the chosen direction. Development, testing, and handover follow when they are included in the project scope.

Can I review the work and request changes?

Yes. Feedback is an important part of the process. Review stages and the included revisions will be agreed on before we begin. Requests that change the original scope can be discussed and quoted separately.

Do you provide support after launch?

Handover, maintenance, and ongoing support can be discussed as part of your project. We will agree on the support period, covered tasks, and any additional fees before work begins.
